_comment: ECU catalogue for the F10 platform.
This file is intentionally EMPTY of addresses. BMW diagnostic addresses
for the F10 have not been verified in this project, and inventing them
would risk addressing the wrong control unit.
'f10diag ecu list' will only ever display ECUs that actually answered a
request. It must never print this file's contents as if they were
The short names below are BMW's well-known abbreviations for control units
and are recorded purely as expected labels. They carry no address, and
their presence in this file is not a claim that the vehicle has them.

_schema.address: diagnostic address as a hex string, or null when unverified
_schema.platform: vehicle platform the entry applies to, e.g. "F10"
_schema.source: where the address came from; required when address is set
_schema.verified: true only when the address has been confirmed on a vehicle
